entries.Translated: 等待 IINACT(WebSocket 重新连接...)

entries.Original: Stock DamageTerror appearance. Use this to reset to factory settings.
entries.Translated: 库存伤害恐惧显示。使用此重置为出厂设置。

entries.Original: Classic MiniParse style — sharp bars, dark background, compact layout.
entries.Translated: 经典的 MiniParse 风格——锐条、深色背景、紧凑布局。

entries.Original: Modern compact bars with warm tones and slight rounding.
entries.Translated: 现代紧凑的酒吧，色调温暖，略带圆润。

entries.Original: Minimal horizontal bars — thin, rounded, highly transparent.
entries.Translated: 最小水平条——细、圆、高度透明。

entries.Original: Colorful rounded bars with unique per-job colors and vibrant styling.
entries.Translated: 色彩鲜艳的圆形条纹，每个作品都有独特的颜色和生动的风格。

entries.Original: Data-dense table layout — all stats visible, compact rows, sharp edges.
entries.Translated: 数据密集型表格布局——所有统计数据都可见，行紧凑，边缘清晰。

entries.Original: Game-integrated look — desaturated per-job colors, subtle rounding, HUD-like feel.
entries.Translated: 游戏整合的外观——不饱和的工作色彩，微妙的圆润，类似 HUD 的感觉。

entries.Original: Damage numbers - the meter's bread and butter.
entries.Translated: 损坏数字——仪表的面包和黄油。

entries.Original: No visible meter tabs found. Tabs are managed under Settings -> Tabs.
entries.Translated: 未找到可见的仪表标签。标签可在 “设置”->“标签” 下管理。

entries.Original: Pick the meter tab whose columns you want to set up. The preview meter switches to whichever tab you select - run this wizard again to do another tab.
entries.Translated: 选择您想要设置其列的仪表选项卡。预览仪表会切换到您选择的任何选项卡——再次运行此向导以创建另一个选项卡。

entries.Original: This tab is in graph mode - columns apply to its bars view.
entries.Translated: 此选项卡处于图表模式——列应用于其条形图视图。

entries.Original: Everything else - hit stats, defense, and group-wide numbers.
entries.Translated: 其他一切——命中数据、防御能力和整个群体的数据。

entries.Original: Arrange the enabled columns - the top of this list is the leftmost column on the meter.
entries.Translated: 排列已启用的列——此列表的顶部是仪表上最左侧的列。

entries.Original: No columns enabled - go back and tick some first.
entries.Translated: 没有启用列——先回去勾选一些。

entries.Original: Columns set. Per-column extras - custom labels, formats, value colors, and widths - live under Settings -> Appearance.
entries.Translated: 设置列。每列附加项——自定义标签、格式、值颜色和宽度——在 “设置”->“外观” 下直播。

entries.Original: Finishing clears the sample data from the meter.
entries.Translated: 完成后，样本数据将从仪表中清除。

entries.Original: Colors first - the preview meter beside this window updates as you pick.
entries.Translated: 颜色优先——此窗口旁边的预览指示器会随着您的选择而更新。

entries.Original: Off: one color per role. On: a color for every job.
entries.Translated: 关闭：每个角色一种颜色。开启：每个任务一种颜色。

entries.Original: How each combatant's job shows up on the meter bars.
entries.Translated: 每个战士的工作如何在仪表盘上显示。

entries.Original: Per-job icon IDs live under Settings → Appearance → Meter Bars.
entries.Translated: 每个工作图标 ID 在 “设置”→“外观”→“仪表盘” 下直播。

entries.Original: Shows the job tag, e.g. [WAR], in front of each name.
entries.Translated: 在每个名字前显示工作标签，例如 [WAR]。

entries.Original: Markings that call out your bar and the meter's rows.
entries.Translated: 显示你的条形图和仪表行的标记。

entries.Original: That's the quick pass. Everything here - and much more - can be found under Settings → Appearance.
entries.Translated: 这就是快速通行证。这里的一切——以及更多内容——都可以在 “设置”→“外观” 下找到。

entries.Original: Welcome to Damage Terror! This quick setup covers the essentials — everything here can be changed later in Settings.
entries.Translated: 欢迎来到伤害恐惧！这个快速设置涵盖了基本内容——这里的一切都可以稍后在设置中进行更改。

entries.Original: First: where should combat data come from?
entries.Translated: 首先：战斗数据应该来自哪里？

entries.Original: Talks directly to the IINACT Dalamud plugin. No extra setup.
entries.Translated: 直接与 IINACT Damud 插件通话。无需额外设置。

entries.Original: Not connected yet? You can keep going — the connection can be sorted out any time under Settings → General.
entries.Translated: 还没连接吗？你可以继续——连接可以在 “设置”→“通用” 下随时解决。

entries.Original: The meter beside this window is showing sample combat data. Click a preset to try it on — whatever you leave selected is what you keep.
entries.Translated: 这个窗口旁边的仪表显示的是样本战斗数据。点击一个预设来尝试——无论你选择什么，都将保留你所选择的内容。

entries.Original: Reorder the meter's parts below, and tick the box beside a part to hide it until you hold the reveal shortcut. Set the shortcut below — the preview beside this window updates as you go.
entries.Translated: 在下方重新排列仪表的各个部件，然后勾选某个部件旁边的方框以隐藏它，直到您按住显示快捷键。在下方设置快捷键——此窗口旁边的预览会随着您的操作而更新。

entries.Original:
Hold: active only while keys are pressed.
Toggle: press once to activate, press again to deactivate.
entries.Translated:
保持：仅在按下按键时激活。
切换：按一次即可激活，再按一次即可停用。

entries.Original: Put the meter where you want it. Drag the preview meter to move it, drag its edges to resize - or use the controls below.
entries.Translated: 将指示器放在想要的位置。拖动预览指示器以移动它，拖动其边缘以调整大小——或使用下方的控制。

entries.Original: Locked: the meter can't be dragged or resized. The lock icon on the meter's title bar toggles this too.
entries.Translated: 锁定：仪表无法拖动或调整大小。仪表标题栏上的锁定图标也会切换此选项。

entries.Original: A couple of behavior choices — the rest lives in Settings when you want it.
entries.Translated: 几个行为选择——剩下的在 “设置” 中随时可用。
在插件启动时打开仪表

entries.Original: When disabled, the meter stays hidden until you open it with /dt.
entries.Translated: 禁用后，仪表将保持隐藏状态，直到您使用/dt 打开它。

entries.Original: The meter fades out a few seconds after combat ends and returns when a new fight starts.
entries.Translated: 战斗结束后几秒钟，仪表会消失，当新的战斗开始时再次显示。

entries.Original: Play a finished encounter back through the meter. When off, the Replay buttons and the Replay Bar layout entry are hidden.
entries.Translated: 通过指示器播放已完成的对话。关闭时，重播按钮和重播栏布局条目会被隐藏。

entries.Original: Untick to watch the countdown that tucks the meter away after combat ends.
entries.Translated: 无需点击即可观看战斗结束后收起仪表的倒计时。

entries.Original: All set! A few things worth remembering:
entries.Translated: 一切就绪！几件值得记住的事情：

entries.Original: You can re-run this setup any time from Settings → General.
entries.Translated: 您可以随时从 “设置”→“通用” 重新运行此设置。

entries.Original: Keep going with the other wizards - each is also available later under Settings -> General:
entries.Translated: 继续与其他巫师合作——每位巫师稍后都可以在 “设置” 下找到——>通用：

entries.Original: Search by zone, title, player, or job...
entries.Translated: 按区域、头衔、玩家或职业搜索......

entries.Original: No timeline data available — replay unavailable for this encounter.
entries.Translated: 时间线数据不可用——本次遭遇无法重放。

entries.Original: No graph metrics enabled. Enable DPS, HPS, or DTPS in the tab's graph settings.
entries.Translated: 未启用图表指标。在选项卡的图表设置中启用 DPS、HPS 或 DTPS。
还没有足够的图表数据。

entries.Original: Pin the replay bar so it stays visible without holding the modifier key.
entries.Translated: 固定回放栏，使其保持可见，而不需要按住修饰键。

entries.Original:
Pinned: replay bar stays visible even if the modifier key is required.
Click to unpin.
entries.Translated:
固定：即使需要修饰键，回放栏仍然可见。
点击取消固定。

entries.Original: Setup preview - the replay bar only works during an actual encounter replay.
entries.Translated: 设置预览——回放栏仅在实际遭遇回放时有效。

entries.Original: No encounter data. Make sure IINACT is running.
entries.Translated: 没有遭遇数据。确保 IINACT 正在运行。

entries.Original: No combat data, go hit something!
entries.Translated: 没有战斗数据，去打点什么吧！

entries.Original: No combatants match this tab's filter.
entries.Translated: 没有战斗机匹配此选项卡的筛选器。
断开连接 - 通知 - 弹出

entries.Original: Not enough data to graph yet.
entries.Translated: 还没有足够的数据来绘制图表。

entries.Original: Display a custom image behind the meter window.
entries.Translated: 在仪表窗口后显示自定义图像。

entries.Original: Tip: Right-click custom presets in the dropdown to delete or export them.
entries.Translated: 提示：右键单击下拉菜单中的自定义预置以删除或导出它们。

entries.Original: Save current settings as a custom preset:
entries.Translated: 将当前设置存储为自定义预设：
从剪贴板粘贴预设 JSON:

entries.Original: Set a game icon ID per job (0 = default framed).
entries.Translated: 为每个作业设置游戏图标 ID(0 = 默认帧)。

entries.Original: Click while holding SHIFT to reset
entries.Translated: 点击并按住 SHIFT 以重置

entries.Original: Encounter history is saved automatically and persists across restarts.
entries.Translated: 遭遇历史记录会自动保存，并在重启期间持续存在。

entries.Original: Import from file (recommended for large encounters):
entries.Translated: 从文件导入 (建议用于大型相遇场景):
或粘贴导出的 JSON 相遇：

entries.Original: Encounter has no replayable timeline data.
entries.Translated: 相遇没有可重放的时间线数据。

entries.Original: When enabled, allows loading a custom system font. Disable if you experience crashes.
entries.Translated: 当启用时，允许加载自定义系统字体。如果遇到崩溃，则禁用。

entries.Original: Enable custom font above to use font selection.
entries.Translated: 启用上述自定义字体以使用字体选择。

entries.Original: Set the font size for each component independently.
entries.Translated: 独立设置每个组件的字体大小。

entries.Original:
Shorten Max Hit / Max Heal skill names when they exceed this length.
Each word after the first is replaced by its initial. 0 = disabled.
entries.Translated:
当超过这个长度时，缩短 Max Hit/Max Heal 技能名称。
第一个单词后面的每个单词都会被其首字母替换。0 = 禁用。

entries.Original: Walks through data source, theme preset, and core behavior again. Nothing changes until you pick something.
entries.Translated: 再次浏览数据源、主题预设和核心行为。在你选择某个内容之前，什么都不会改变。

entries.Original: A quick pass over colors, icons, and markings. The full set of options can be found under Appearance.
entries.Translated: 快速浏览颜色、图标和标记。完整的选项集可以在外观下找到。

entries.Original: Pick which columns a meter tab shows and their order. Per-column extras live under Appearance.
entries.Translated: 选择仪表板上显示的列及其顺序。每列额外数据显示在 “外观” 下。
首选 IPC(进程中，最低延迟)
不要存储 0 个 eDPS 遭遇

entries.Original: Ignore ESC key closing the meter
entries.Translated: 忽略 ESC 键关闭仪表

entries.Original:
DamageTerror: distributes aggregated DoT ticks across active statuses using potency weights. (needed for dot skill breakdown)
IINACT / ACT: trusts the parser's own DoT simulation and attributes each tick to the named source as-is. (no DoT skill breakdown)
entries.Translated:
DamageTerror:使用效能权重在活跃状态间分配聚合 DoT 刻度。(需要点技能分解)
IINACT / ACT:信任解析器自身的 DoT 模拟，并将每个刻度归因于命名源。(无 DoT 技能崩溃)

entries.Original: Modifier key used by hidden layout elements and header reveal.
entries.Translated: 用于隐藏布局元素和标题显示的修饰键。
现场行动 (尤里卡/博兹亚)
实地突袭 (德卢布鲁姆/达里阿达)

entries.Original: Damage Terror keeps an automatic copy of your configuration so a corrupt or unreadable file can be recovered.
entries.Translated: 损坏恐惧会自动备份您的配置，以便恢复已损坏或无法读取的文件。

entries.Original: Force-write the .bak file even if the throttle window hasn't elapsed.
entries.Translated: 强制写入.bak 文件，即使节流窗口尚未过期。

entries.Original: No recovery files on disk yet.
entries.Translated: 磁盘上还没有恢复文件。

entries.Original: Replace the current configuration with this recovery file?
entries.Translated: 用这个恢复文件替换当前配置？

entries.Original: You'll need to reload Damage Terror for the restored config to take effect.
entries.Translated: 您需要重新加载损坏恐惧才能使恢复的配置生效。

entries.Original: In-game: Settings -> Plugin Installer -> Damage Terror -> Disable then Enable,
entries.Translated: 游戏内：设置->插件安装程序->伤害恐惧->禁用后再启用，

entries.Original: or run /xlplugin and toggle the plugin from there.
entries.Translated: 或者运行/xlplugin 并从那里切换插件。

entries.Original: Configuration restored. Reload Damage Terror to apply.
entries.Translated: 配置已恢复。重新加载损坏恐惧以应用。

entries.Original: Restore failed. Check the plugin log for details.
entries.Translated: 还原失败。查看插件日志了解详细信息。

entries.Original: During combat, scroll the graph to show only the most recent time window instead of the full encounter.
entries.Translated: 在战斗中，滚动图表只显示最近的时间窗口，而不是整个遭遇战。

entries.Original: How quickly the graph scrolls to the new position. Higher = snappier, lower = smoother.
entries.Translated: 图表滚动到新位置的速度。高=更快，低=更平滑。

entries.Original: Configure the appearance of the graph view mode. Each tab can be switched to graph view in the Tabs settings page.
entries.Translated: 配置图表视图模式的外观。每个选项卡都可以在 “选项卡设置” 页面中切换到图表视图。

entries.Original:
Drag the components to change their rendering order in the meter window.
Use the arrow buttons to move items up or down.
entries.Translated:
拖动组件以更改其在仪表窗口中的渲染顺序。
使用箭头按钮上下移动项目。

entries.Original: Only show this component while the modifier key is active.
entries.Translated: 仅在修饰键处于活跃状态时显示此组件。

entries.Original:
When enabled, adds a tab bar to the main meter window.
Each tab can filter and sort combatants independently.
entries.Translated:
启用后，在主仪表窗口中添加一个标签栏。
每个选项卡都可以独立过滤和排序战斗人员。

entries.Original: Enable meter tabs above to configure them.
entries.Translated: 启用上面的仪表选项卡来配置它们。

entries.Original: Select a tab from the list to configure it.
entries.Translated: 从列表中选择一个选项卡来配置它。

entries.Original:
Fixed width for each tab button.
Set to 0 to auto-size based on text.
entries.Translated:
每个选项卡按钮的固定宽度。
设置为 0 以根据文本自动调整大小。

entries.Original:
Assign this tab to a group.
Tabs with the same group string are grouped together.
entries.Translated:
将此标签页分配给一个组。
具有相同群组字符串的标签会被分组在一起。

entries.Original:
Hide this tab from the tab bar.
The tab still exists and can be used for popout windows.
entries.Translated:
隐藏标签页栏中的此标签页。
该选项卡仍然存在，可用于弹出窗口。

entries.Original:
Filter by party membership.
Solo = only you.
Party Only = your party members.
Alliance = all alliance members.
Combines with Role Filter above.
entries.Translated:
按队伍成员进行筛选。
Solo =只有你。
只有党员=你的党员。
联盟=所有联盟成员。
结合上述角色滤镜。

entries.Original:
Switch between traditional bars and a line graph overlay.
Graph mode plots metrics over time for all combatants.
You can toggle the view mode from the titlebar or context menu.
entries.Translated:
在传统条形图和折线图叠加之间切换。
图形模式随时间推移绘制所有作战参与者的指标。
您可以从标题栏或上下文菜单中切换视图模式。

entries.Original: Starts a new line with this metric
entries.Translated: 使用此度量值开始新行
自定义值颜色 (点击编辑)

entries.Original:
When enabled, per-metric custom colors are used even during active encounters.
When disabled, active encounters always use the active encounter color.
entries.Translated:
当启用时，即使在活跃的相遇中也会使用按度量自定义颜色。
当禁用时，活跃邂逅始终使用活跃邂逅颜色。

entries.Original: These metrics specifically abide by this tab's filters
entries.Translated: 这些指标特别遵循本选项卡的筛选器。

entries.Original: These settings apply everywhere player names are displayed.
entries.Translated: 这些设置适用于所有显示玩家名称的位置。
显示 “YOU” 而非字符名称

entries.Original: Custom name color for local player
entries.Translated: 本地玩家的自定义名称颜色

entries.Original: Window is locked. Using these controls will update its pinned position and size.
entries.Translated: 窗口已锁定。使用这些控件将更新固定的位置和大小。

entries.Original: Snap the meter window to a screen edge or corner.
entries.Translated: 将仪表窗口粘贴到屏幕边缘或角落。

entries.Original:
Load a simulated encounter to preview and test your UI settings.
Sample data is temporary and will not be saved to history.
entries.Translated:
加载模拟遭遇来预览和测试 UI 设置。
样本数据是临时的，不会保存为历史。

entries.Original: When enabled, numbers will fluctuate in real-time like a live encounter.
entries.Translated: 当启用时，数字将实时波动，就像现场遭遇一样。

entries.Original: players). Enable simulation and check the main meter window.
entries.Translated: 玩家。启用模拟并检查主仪表窗口。

entries.Original:
Number of top skills to show when "Top Damage Skills" or
"Top Healing Skills" tooltip fields are enabled.
entries.Translated:
当 “顶级伤害技能” 或
“顶级治疗技能” 工具提示栏已启用。

entries.Original: Toggle the meter window. Subcommands: config, toggle <group>
entries.Translated: 切换仪表窗口。子命令:config，切换<group>
